BK_KO.why: omitted flag == all 32, and no cell list

REPORTABLE_AS: 72 single-cell effects E(BK_H<h>_L<ll>) = the MEAN OVER THE 23 DOMAINS of (y_install(cell) - y_install(BK_BASE)), each with a percentile bootstrap ci95 over DOMAIN resamples; the eight whole-head HD_<h> arms supplying the S-311 bars and the ADMISSION decision, EXCLUDED from every per-cell count; and the BK_KO all-32 denominator. ⚠ The first freeze omitted this key entirely, so the census REFUSED the prereg before loading any arm -- after ~3.9 GPU-hours would have been spent (R32-A/R32-B). It is also where the ESTIMATOR is defined, so without it the family had no estimator definition anywhere, a PART I 3.5 violation.
CANNOT_DO: whether the screen predicts for heads that are NULL on basket -- this family admits only live ones, by construction
anything about the OTHER 24 heads, or about cells outside band 6-14
anything about the SOURCE of the effect (S-316/AM-40 stand; the mass instrument's criterion licenses a REFUTATION reading only, S-337/S-343)
whether the screen's sub-argmax ORDERING transfers -- S-307 measured that it does not
SELECTION_RE_ENTERS_WHEN: any head is added, re-ordered, or dropped OTHER THAN BY THE FROZEN ADMISSION RULE, after an arm has run. ⚠ The first freeze said 'added, dropped or re-ordered' without that exception, which contradicted ADMISSION -- whose whole job is to drop heads after the arms have run (R32-A CONCERN 5).
DOSE_IDENTITY_IS_BLIND_HERE: 72 cell arms share a prefill dose of 224 and NINE arms share 2016 (the eight HD_<h> plus BK_KO). The dose therefore carries NO identity information within either group. Arm identity MUST be asserted from each run's own knockout_cells, and for BK_KO from its recording NO cell list (S-292/S-310).
NO_VERDICT: This file contains NO verdict, NO rank and NO p-value by design. Singling out any one head for a claim requires a HELD-OUT AXIS -- see SELECTION_RE_ENTERS_WHEN.

VOID_8_PROVENANCE.WHAT_THIS_IS: each head's whole-head arm E compared to the prereg's frozen prior measurement of the SAME head, codeword and split. A diff above the head's DECLARED void_tolerance is a refusal, not a warning. The tolerance may not be defaulted by this reader. (R29/S-323, R30-A/S-332)

DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED.method: the S-311 RULE, computed at read time from this family's own HD_<h> arms

BAR_IS_A_RULE.rule: bar(h) = z * SD(per-domain paired delta of HD_<h> minus the base arm, ddof=1) / sqrt(n_domains)
BAR_IS_A_RULE.DDOF_IS_PINNED: S-318 verified ddof=1 reproduces published bars exactly
BAR_IS_A_RULE.WHY_NOT_A_NUMBER: a bar must come from the family it judges

DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED.⚠ NOT_HELD_OUT: THE SCREEN IS basket TRAIN AND THIS CENSUS IS basket VALIDATION, so the LAYER is held out on SPLIT ONLY -- **NOT on codeword**. PR-CSI-018 was held out on BOTH (a basket screen predicting BUTTON cells), so D39's framing is STRONGER than anything this family can claim and must not be carried over to it. The HEAD SET is chosen using PR-CSI-012's basket validation magnitudes, i.e. the SAME split this family reads. ⚠ THE FIRST FREEZE DEFENDED THIS WITH THE WRONG ARGUMENT -- that liveness is a whole-head property while the test is which CELL within a head. R32-A showed that defends the wrong thing: selecting heads on whole-head validation magnitude CAN tilt the marginal distribution of argmax layers, and BOTH the binomial and the conditional rest on a uniform-over-9 null that S-351 measured to be empirically wrong. WHAT ACTUALLY PROTECTS THE FAMILY is the PERMUTATION component: it conditions on the observed argmaxes, so a shared band bias cannot fake it, and because GATING is weakest_of_three the gate is valid whenever ANY ONE component is. PR-CSI-018's frozen read said this in terms; the first freeze of this family replaced it and lost the argument that works.
DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED.NOT_THE_PRIMARY: the bar governs the depth map's CLEARS/does-not-clear; the PRIMARY is argmax agreement and does not use the bar

CELL_FAMILY.WEAKER_CRITERION_NOTE: n_cells_with_ci95_excluding_0 is NOT the preregistered criterion. The prereg froze |E| > that head's own preregistered_bar_per_head entry. A cell can exclude 0 at a small fraction of the bar and with the wrong sign; on PR-CSI-014 CL_L11 did exactly that (S-299/S-300). ⚠ AND THE CONVERSE, measured on THIS family (R27/S-308): the bar is 1.96*SE of the NINE-CELL HEAD arm, whose per-domain spread is much larger than a single cell's, so cells exclude 0 far below it -- 7 of PR-CSI-015's 24 non-clearing cells do, the smallest at 14% of the bar. 'Below the bar' therefore means NOT DETECTABLE AT THE PREREGISTERED RESOLUTION, and must NOT be read as 'this cell shows no effect'.
